items.title: Sharing a Turkey Feast Platter
items.alt: Two pairs of hands pass a roast-turkey platter above separate bowls of mashed potatoes and green beans.
items.description: Red and green sweater sleeves frame the serving action, with cranberry and herb garnish ringing the large roast.

items.title: Older Couple Serving a Turkey Feast
items.alt: A smiling older couple serves roast turkey at a small table with stuffing, green beans and a lattice-topped pie.
items.description: The silver-haired woman in a blue apron holds a carving utensil while the bespectacled man in a green cardigan waits with a plate.

items.title: Turkey Feast Catering Trolley
items.alt: A metal catering trolley carries roast turkey beneath an open cloche, with green beans, rolls and berry desserts.
items.description: Brass-colored rails surround the two silver shelves, and dark caster wheels anchor the tall handle and compact mobile spread.

items.title: Floral Celebration Dessert Table
items.alt: An ivory two-tier cake, berry cupcakes and strawberries stand on a small white table decorated with flowers and greenery.
items.description: Curved table legs and a draped foliage garland give the compact dessert arrangement a soft oval silhouette.

items.title: Storybook King at a Turkey Banquet
items.alt: A cheerful fictional cartoon king raises a gold goblet behind a table with roast turkey, savory pie and grapes.
items.description: An auburn curled beard, purple fur-trimmed robe and jeweled crown distinguish the seated character above the compact round banquet table.

items.title: Woodland Friends Sharing a Feast
items.alt: A squirrel, hedgehog and rabbit share pie, berries and nuts around a small tree-stump table.
items.description: Different face shapes and green, blue and cream clothing distinguish the animals as they hold food beside bowls set around the pie.
